name: ISO Submachine Gun
description_html:
Submachine gun imported from the parallel world of Call of Duty:

Five versions are included:

ZLR ISO 9 G – 9x19mm Glock Mag 850rpm

Expedite Firearms ISO 9 G – 9x19mm Glock Mag 1000rpm
Expedite Firearms ISO 9 – 9x19mm MP9 Mag 1000rpm
Expedite Firearms ISO 45 G – .45ACP Glock Mag 900rpm
Expedite Firearms ISO 45 – .45ACP Proprietary Mag 900rpm

With 5 types of extented handgaurd, 4 types of barrel modification, 3 types of pistol grip modification and 2 types of stock modification.

Default stocks of every versions are retractable.

Models and textures are properties of Actvision;
